_comment: TOON devnet — rolling-swap maker config skeleton (issue #983, toon-meta#402). Consumed by `toon-swap --config` (toon-protocol/swap packages/swap/src/cli.ts) inside the swap-node service (./docker-compose.relay.swap.yml). Standalone-maker wiring per toon-meta#402's proven rig: no `connector`/`connectorUrl` set, so the CLI auto-creates an embedded, parentless ConnectorNode gated on `btpServerPort` — the direct-dial model swap#105 proved, where a client reaches this maker by dialing its public `btpEndpoint` rather than through the relay's own routing table. `mnemonic`/`secretKey` are deliberately ABSENT: identity is generated on-box (never committed) and injected as `SWAP_MNEMONIC` by ./docker-compose.relay.swap.yml's entrypoint, which reads it from a mounted key-file path — see docs/operators/swap-node-bringup.md.
_swapPairs_comment: PLACEHOLDER pair, same-chain USDC at parity — enough for the CLI's non-empty-swapPairs precondition and for `docker compose config`/CLI-boot smoke testing. The real trading pair(s) this maker quotes (which chain(s) it accepts leg-A payment on, at what rate) are a business decision toon-meta#402 does not pin; a human must replace this before the maker is useful. See docs/operators/swap-node-bringup.md's 'What this leaves open'.
_channels_comment: channelId is the clearly-marked placeholder convention this repo uses elsewhere for a not-yet-opened on-chain channel (issues #822/#853/#871's `0xdead...` values). Replaced with the REAL leg-B RollingSwapChannel channel id once a human opens and funds it (docs/operators/swap-node-bringup.md step 'Leg-B channel + gas').
_inventory_comment: 0 until the leg-B channel above is actually funded — an unfunded maker quoting nonzero inventory would issue claims it cannot honor.
_chainProviders_comment: registryAddress/tokenAddress are the SAME TokenNetworkRegistry/USDC deployment infra/linode-relay/connector-rust.toml's own [settlement.evm] uses (fleet-wide agreement, ADR: a claim resolves against one deployment). channelAddress is the deployed RollingSwapChannel (issue #974/#973) — the leg-B contract this maker signs v2 EIP-712 balance-proof claims against. `keyId` is left unset: swap-node.ts defaults it to `settlementPrivateKey` below.
_tokenNetworkAddress_comment: LEG A, and a different contract from channelAddress — the deployed TokenNetwork for this chain+token, which is what the maker's kind:10032 `tokenNetworks` advertises so a client can open the channel it pays this maker over. swap#134 (issue swap#133) made this REQUIRED with no default, deliberately: defaulting it to channelAddress would have made the maker boot while announcing a contract every client's ensureChannel reverts on. THIS FILE IS WHY ADR 0041 EXISTS. swap#134 merged green on 2026-08-16, `swap:release` moved, the relay box's Watchtower recreated swap-node within ~60s, and the maker crash-looped on `[INVALID_CONFIG] chainProviders[0].tokenNetworkAddress MUST be a non-empty string` because this committed file — bind-mounted at /app/config/swap.config.json, and not part of the image — did not have the key. A human added it live to stop the loop; this commit is that value, brought back into the repo, so a redeploy from the committed tree does not reproduce the outage. Do not remove it, and see docs/operators/fleet-release-and-health.md before adding a required key to any app on this fleet.
_channelAddress_comment: channelAddress is the RollingSwapChannel deployed 2026-08-15 (docs/rolling-swap-channel-deployment.md), whose token is IMMUTABLE and is the retired mock USDC 0x49beE1…a9Ce, not the devnet USDC tokenAddress now names (#1337). The maker is not deployed on the devnet today, so nothing live reads this; before one is, redeploy it for the new token through funded-ops.yml's deploy-rolling-swap-channel (its TOKEN constant already names the new token) and put the new address here.
_settlementPrivateKey_comment: Same `0xdead...` placeholder-policy value as `channels` above, chosen so it passes the CLI's `0x[0-9a-fA-F]{64}` boot-time format check but is obviously not a real key. This is NOT overwritten by the `SWAP_MNEMONIC` env overlay — packages/swap/src/cli.ts's `applyEnvOverlay` only sets `mnemonic`/`secretKey` from env, never `settlementPrivateKey` — so a box that boots with only SWAP_MNEMONIC set would sign leg-B claims with THIS placeholder scalar, not the derived key, and every claim would be worthless. toon-meta#402's proven wiring requires the BIP-44 account-index-2 key here (the same key `deriveSwapNodeKeys`/D12-011 derives, distinct from the index-0 Nostr identity `mnemonic` yields), and the CLI has no 'derive index-2 and use it here' knob yet (open gap, packages/swap/src/cli.ts). A human must compute that key from the on-box mnemonic and set it in a box-local, UNCOMMITTED copy of this file before the maker can issue a redeemable claim. See docs/operators/swap-node-bringup.md.
_relayUrls_comment: Non-empty only because swap-node.ts's `validateConfig` throws 'SwapNodeConfig.relayUrls MUST be a non-empty array' before allocating any resource — under this compose service's `restart: unless-stopped` an empty array crash-loops the container forever. The value itself is inert: this maker never writes to a Nostr relay directly (the SimplePool/relayUrls publish path is refused by a pay-to-write TOON relay anyway — see swap-node.ts's `peerInfoIlpDestination` doc), so it is set to the live relay this maker announces through (harmless if ever exercised) rather than a placeholder host. Its kind:10032 is instead published by the SEPARATE paid-announce loop, ./docker-compose.relay.swap-announce.yml, mirroring how infra/linode-relay/docker-compose.relay.announce.yml and infra/linode-store/docker-compose.store.announce.yml announce THEIR nodes. (swap-node.ts's own `peerInfoIlpDestination`/`peerInfoPricePerByte` boot-time self-publish is NOT used here. packages/swap/src/cli.ts forwards both fields as of swap#124, so it would now be reachable via `toon-swap --config` — but this fleet announces every node the one way (`connector announce`, ./docker-compose.relay.swap-announce.yml), which is what fleet-ops.yml's `announce` operation forces and reads a verdict line back from. A second, differently-shaped publisher on the same identity would be a second writer on one (pubkey, kind:10032) slot for no gain.)
_blsPort_comment: 8090, NOT 8080 — matching the live relay box (verified 2026-08-16). The maker already binds its own health/metrics server on 8080 (`Swap node listening on http://localhost:8080`, the port ./docker-compose.relay.swap.yml publishes on loopback and fleet-health.yml probes), so a `blsPort` of 8080 is a second bind on the same port and the process dies with `EADDRINUSE :::8080` AFTER passing validateConfig. Found by booting this committed file against `ghcr.io/toon-protocol/swap:release`, which is the whole argument for ADR 0041's gate: config validity is not bootability, and only actually starting the image proves the second. The box was hand-fixed and the fix was never committed; this brings it back.
